rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for saying that something is completely or thoroughly done or true.

example.english: I thoroughly understand what you mean.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jyun4 cyun4 ming4 baak6 nei5 ge3 ji3 si1

rows.note: Use V + 晒 when an action has been completed in full or everything has been used up or dealt with.

example.english: I thoroughly organized all the documents.
example.traditional: 我已經將啲文件整理晒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 ging1 zoeng1 di1 man4 gin2 zing2 lei5 saai3

rows.note: Use this especially for carrying out an investigation, cleaning, or change in a thorough and exhaustive way.

example.english: The police thoroughly investigated the whole matter.
example.traditional: 警方徹底調查咗成件事。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 cit3 dai2 tiu4 caa4 zo2 sing4 gin6 si6
